transcript.en: So if you're one of those people who hasn't found the perfect physical activity yet -
transcript.zh: 如果你也还没有找到最适合自己的体育活动，

transcript.en: here are some things to think about which might help you make the right decision for you.
transcript.zh: 以下是一些需要考虑的事情，可以帮助你做出正确决定。

transcript.en: The first question to ask yourself is whether you would enjoy training in a gym.
transcript.zh: 首先要问自己的问题是，是否喜欢在健身房锻炼。

transcript.en: Many people are put off by the idea of having to fit a visit to the gym into their busy day -
transcript.zh: 许多人因为想到在忙碌了一天之后还得去健身房而不愿去 -

transcript.en: you often have to go very early or late as some gyms can get very crowded.
transcript.zh: 健身房还经常人满为患，只能早点去或晚点去。

transcript.en: But with regular training you'll see a big difference in a relatively short space of time.
transcript.zh: 但是只要定期锻炼，在短期内就可以看到明显的效果。

transcript.en: Running has become incredibly popular in recent years.
transcript.zh: 近几年来，跑步变得非常受欢迎。

transcript.en: That's probably got a lot to do with the fact that it's a very accessible form of exercise - anyone can run
transcript.zh: 这很可能是因为这是一种很方便的锻炼方式

transcript.en: even if you can only run a few metres to begin with.
transcript.zh: 即使一开始只能跑很短的距离。

transcript.en: But make sure you get the right shoes – it's worth investing in a high quality pair and they don't come cheap.
transcript.zh: 但是一定要确保穿对鞋子 - 一双高质量的鞋子是非常值得的，虽然这种鞋子价格并不便宜。

transcript.en: Another great thing about running is that you can do it at any time of day or night - the only thing that may stop you is snow and ice.
transcript.zh: 跑步的另一个好处就是，不论是白天还是晚上，任何时候都可以跑步 - 是非是雨雪天气。

transcript.en: Swimming is another really good way to build fitness.
transcript.zh: 游泳是另一种健身的好方法。

transcript.en: What attracts many people is that you can swim in an indoor pool at any time of year.
transcript.zh: 很多人青睐游泳的原因是一年四季室内游泳池都可以游泳。

transcript.en: On the other hand it can be quite boring or solitary - it's hard to chat to people while you're swimming lengths.
transcript.zh: 另一方面，游泳可能有点无聊或者孤独 - 你游泳时，很难与人聊天。

transcript.en: Cycling has become almost as popular as running in recent years.
transcript.zh: 近年来，骑自行车几乎变得和跑步一样流行。

transcript.en: That's probably because as well as improving their fitness, many people say being out in the fresh air in a park or in the countryside can be fun, provided the conditions are right of course —
transcript.zh: 这可能是因为除了健身，很多人认为骑自行车可以让人呼吸到公园或乡村的新鲜空气，

transcript.en: only fanatics go out in the wind and rain!
transcript.zh: 只要不刮风或下雨 - 除非是自行车迷。

transcript.en: Yoga is a good choice for those of you looking for exercise which focuses on developing both a healthy mind and body.
transcript.zh: 对于那些正在寻找锻炼项目的人来说，瑜伽是一个很多的选择，瑜伽主要是培育健康的身心。

transcript.en: It's a good way of building strength and with the right instructor,
transcript.zh: 这是一种锻炼力量的好方法，并且有个好教练，

transcript.en: there's less chance of hurting yourself than with other more active sports.
transcript.zh: 相对于其他更剧烈的运动，练瑜伽身体受伤的可能性更小。

transcript.en: But don't expect to find it easy - it can be surprisingly challenging, especially for people who aren't very flexible.
transcript.zh: 但是不要以为瑜伽很简单 - 它可能会出乎意料的难，尤其是对那些身体不太灵活的人来说。

transcript.en: Getting a personal trainer is a good way to start your fitness programme.
transcript.zh: 由私人教练指导是健身的好方法。

transcript.en: Obviously there can be significant costs involved.
transcript.zh: 虽然费用很高。

transcript.en: But if you've got someone there to encourage you and help you achieve your goals, you're less likely to give up.
transcript.zh: 但是如果有个人在旁边鼓励你、帮助你，那么你就更不可能放弃。

transcript.en: Make sure you get someone with a recognised qualification, though, or you could do yourself permanent damage.
transcript.zh: 尽管如何，一定要确保私教有合格资历，否则可能会受到永久性伤害。

transcript.en: Whatever you do, don't join a gym unless you're sure you'll make good use of it.
transcript.zh: 无论你是做什么工作的，除非你确定健身房适合你自己，否则不要随意加入。

transcript.en: So many people waste lots of money by signing up for membership and then hardly ever go.
transcript.zh: 很多人花大价钱办理了会员，结果几乎一次也没去过。

transcript.en: What happens to their good intentions?
transcript.zh: 他们的出发点哪去了？

transcript.en: I don't think people suddenly stop caring about improving their fitness, or decide they have more important things to do.
transcript.zh: 我不认为这些人突然对健身不关心了，或者认为有更要的事情要做。

transcript.en: I think people lose interest when they don't think they're making enough progress.
transcript.zh: 我认为，当人们认为自己进展缓慢，可能就不愿去了。

transcript.en: That's when they give up hope and stop believing they'll ever achieve their goals.
transcript.zh: 这时他们就会放弃希望，不再相信自己可以实现目标。

transcript.en: Also, what people sometimes don't realise when they start is that it takes a lot of determination and hard work to keep training week after week and lots of people don't have that kind of commitment.
transcript.zh: 而且，人们在开始的时候并没有意识到，需要很大的决心以及大量的努力才能坚持日复一日、周复一周的锻炼，而许多人没有这种决心和毅力。

transcript.en: One thing you can do to help yourself is to set manageable goals - be realistic and don't push yourself too far.
transcript.zh: 你可以做得一件事是设定可管理的目标 - 现实一点，不要制定自己无法企及的目标。

transcript.en: Some people advise writing goals down, but I think it's better to have a flexible approach.
transcript.zh: 有人建议把目标写下来，但我认为灵活变通一点会更好。

transcript.en: Give yourself a really nice treat every time you reach one of your goals.
transcript.zh: 每次达到目标后，好好奖励一下自己。

transcript.en: And don't get too upset if you experience setbacks - it's a journey
transcript.zh: 如果遇到挫折，不要太难过，

transcript.en: there are bound to be difficulties along the way.
transcript.zh: 一段旅程里一定会遇到困难的。
